test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Mr. Akash was __caught red-handed__ stealing money from the cash counter.

options.text: having a negative amount in his bank balance
caught at the moment when he was doing something wrong
in a situation where people were angry with him
in a difficult situation which was hard to deal with

solution:
The correct answer is "**caught at the moment when he was doing something wrong."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined segment means that Mr. Akash was caught in the act of stealing money.
 
• Option 2 provides a concise and accurate substitute for this meaning.
 
• The phrase "red-handed" is often used to describe someone caught in the act of doing something wrong.(रंगे हाथ)
 
 
• Example: Rajesh was caught red-handed taking the money.
 
 
 
• The use of the word "caught" emphasizes that Mr. Akash was apprehended while committing the theft.
 
• Thus, it is clear that the phrase in option 2 can substitute the bracketed phrase.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
